About this Event

Recovery Yoga Flow
Ready to move, stretch, and breathe freely? Join the recovery class that focuses on preventing and addressing aches and pains caused by daily life, running, weight training, and more. These classes will be a mix of Hatha and Slow Vinyasa style classes, rooted in improving flexibility and reducing soreness.
Come as you are and flow with the group – no pressure, just good energy and great yoga! See you on the mat!

Choose the rate that feels sustainable for you!
🌱 Community Rate- If you're on a tight budget $5
🌿 Accessible Rate- For those with limited disposable income $8
🌸 Standard Rate- A sustainable rate for most participants $12
🌻 Supporter Rate- If you have more flexibility $15
🌞 Community Sustainer- Helps make lower-cost spots possible $18
You are still welcome and encouraged to sign up even if you’re unable to make a donation for any reason. Our goal is to make yoga accessible to everyone in our community, and we want everyone to feel welcome on the mat :)

Refund & Cancellation Policy

To request a refund, please contact us at least 24 hours before the start of your scheduled class. Refund requests should be submitted through the ticket details page on Eventbrite. Ticketing fees are not refundable. 
24+ hours before class: You may request a full refund of your donation.Between 24 and 12 hours before class: Refunds are not available. However, you may reschedule your booking for another class of the same donation value.Less than 12 hours before class: No refunds or rescheduling options are available for the original donation.We understand that plans can change and appreciate your understanding of our cancellation policy. This policy helps us plan for class capacity and ensure that our community offerings remain accessible.
